events.text: Run the findings-analyst: produce outputs/history.json and run `.venv/bin/python scripts/verify_history.py outputs/history.json data/committee` until it reports ALL CHECKS PASSED (it also checks the scoring_method layout).

$ cd /data/workspace; cat .claude/agent-memory/findings-analyst/MEMORY.md 2>/dev/null; ls .claude/agent-memory/findings-analyst/; ls -la data/committee/ outputs/ scripts/; for f in data/committee/*; do echo "== $f"; pdfinfo "$f" | grep -E "Pages|Title"; done
$ cd /data/workspace; cat .claude/agent-memory/findings-analyst/committee-pdf-extraction.md; echo ======; cat scripts/verify_history.py

$ cd /data/workspace; S=/tmp/fa/committee; mkdir -p $S; for f in data/committee/*.pdf; do n=$(basename "$f" .pdf); pdftotext "$f" $S/$n.txt; pdftotext -layout "$f" $S/$n.layout.txt; done; wc -l $S/*; cat $S/audit-completed-work-2024-25-annual.layout.txt

$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; cat -A audit-completed-work-2024-25-annual.txt | sed 's/\$$//' | head -150; echo =====; cat audit-completed-work-2025-26-q3.layout.txt; echo ====; cat audit-completed-work-2025-26-q3.txt
$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; cat internal-audit-plan-2025-28.layout.txt
I've finished the inventory and read the three audit papers. Next I'm working through the 35-page risk strategy, then I'll build history.json and verify it.

$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; awk 'BEGIN{RS="\f"} {print "=================== PDF PAGE " NR; print}' risk-management-strategy-2024-27.layout.txt > rms.paged.txt; grep -n "PDF PAGE" rms.paged.txt | head -40; sed -n '/PDF PAGE 1$/,/PDF PAGE 4$/p' rms.paged.txt | cut -c1-150
$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; sed -n '161,597p' rms.paged.txt | cut -c1-160
$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; sed -n '597,1149p' rms.paged.txt | cut -c1-200
$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; sed -n '597,742p' rms.paged.txt | cut -c1-170 | sed 's/  */ /g'
$ cd /data/workspace; .venv/bin/python -c "import pdfplumber; print('ok')" 2>&1; .venv/bin/python -c "import fitz; print('fitz ok')" 2>&1 | tail -1
$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; sed -n '612,676p' rms.paged.txt
Reconstructing the impact table (Table 1) from the layout text; next I'll do the appetite, matrix and band tables.

$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; awk 'BEGIN{RS="\f"} {print "=================== PDF PAGE " NR; print}' risk-management-strategy-2024-27.txt > rms.plain.paged.txt; awk '/PDF PAGE 14$/,/PDF PAGE 16$/' rms.plain.paged.txt | tr '\n' '|' | sed 's/|/ ⏎ /g' | fold -w 200
$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; sed -n '742,955p' rms.paged.txt | cut -c1-200
$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; sed -n '955,1149p' rms.paged.txt | cut -c1-200

$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; sed -n '1149,1900p' rms.paged.txt | grep -n -i -E "PDF PAGE|fraud|procure|contract|supplier|payment|score|likelihood|impact|matrix|appetite|register|partner|^ *[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ " | cut -c1-180
$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; sed -n '1149,1900p' rms.paged.txt | sed -n '1,30p;119,140p;274,310p;543,626p;640,670p'| cut -c1-170
$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; awk '/PDF PAGE 31$/,/PDF PAGE 32$/' rms.paged.txt | tail -15; awk '/PDF PAGE 26$/,/PDF PAGE 27$/' rms.paged.txt | head -14
I've read all four papers. Now writing the build script that assembles history.json and checks every quote before the verifier runs.

$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; awk '/PDF PAGE 16$/,/PDF PAGE 20$/' rms.plain.paged.txt | grep -v '^$' | tr '\n' '|' | fold -w 220; echo; awk '/PDF PAGE 21$/,/PDF PAGE 22$/' rms.plain.paged.txt | grep -v '^$' | tr '\n' '|' | fold -w 220
Write /tmp/fa/build.py
$ cd /data/workspace; .venv/bin/python -I /tmp/fa/build.py
$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; grep -n -A22 "information for each audit" internal-audit-plan-2025-28.txt; awk '/PDF PAGE 14$/,/PDF PAGE 15$/' rms.plain.paged.txt | grep -n -B3 -A3 "^Death"

$ cd /tmp/fa; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='build.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('"The key risks involved in that area. (b) The level of risk associated with the audit area/function, as assessed by Internal Audit.", section="5.7(a)-(b)"',
 '"The information for each audit covers: (a) (b) (c) (d) (e) The key risks involved in that area. The level of risk associated with the audit area/function, as assessed by Internal Audit.", section="5.7(a)-(b)", note="Plain text prints the (a)-(e) markers before the item texts."')
s=s.replace('"The type of audit, setting out any direct links with the Council Strategy and Corporate Risk Register. (d) Date last reviewed."',
 '"The type of audit, setting out any direct links with the Council Strategy and Corporate Risk Register. Date last reviewed."')
s=s.replace('cq[k] = S(RMS, 14, txt if len(norm(txt)) >= 12 else txt, printed_page=14, section="Table 1")',
 'cq[k] = S(RMS, 14, txt if len(norm(txt)) >= 12 else SHORT[txt], printed_page=14, section="Table 1")')
s=s.replace('impact_scale = []\n', 'impact_scale = []\nSHORT = {"Death": "Death Destruction of building, IT infrastructure"}  # cell under 12 chars: quoted with next cell\n',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cd /data/workspace; .venv/bin/python -I /tmp/fa/build.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/verify_history.py outputs/history.json data/committee
$ cd /tmp/fa/committee; grep -n "Actual level" risk-management-strategy-2024-27.txt | cat -A | head; grep -n 'GLYPHS = ' -A1 /data/workspace/scripts/verify_history.py | cat -A | cut -c1-200
Verifier passes all but one quote; checking why my pre-check and the verifier disagree on it.

$ cd /data/workspace; grep -n "Actual level" /tmp/fa/build.py; grep -n "^def norm" -A5 /tmp/fa/build.py; grep -n "Actual level" outputs/history.json | head -3; diff <(sed -n '1,40p' /tmp/fa/build.py) <(sed -n '1,40p' /tmp/fa/build.py) >/dev/null; ls -la /tmp/fa
$ cd /data/workspace; sed -n 1,80p /tmp/fa/build.py | grep -n -E "ERR|def S|hits|return d"

$ cd /data/workspace; .venv/bin/python -I - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import verify_history as v
from pathlib import Path
ps=v.pages(Path('data/committee/risk-management-strategy-2024-27.pdf'))
p=ps[12]; i=p.find('Actual level'); print(repr(p[i-20:i+200]))
q="Actual level this is the current likelihood and impact, based on mitigation action already put in place but excluding further mitigation action planned."
print(v.normalise(q) in p)
EOF
$ cd /data/workspace; grep -n "BULLET_RE = " scripts/verify_history.py | od -c | head -5

$ cd /tmp/fa; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='build.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('"Actual level this is the current','"Actual level - this is the current')
s=s.replace('def norm(t):
','sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
from verify_history import normalise as _vnorm  # use the verifier's exact normaliser


def norm(t):
    return _vnorm(t)


def _old_norm(t):
',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cd /data/workspace; .venv/bin/python -I /tmp/fa/build.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/verify_history.py outputs/history.json data/committee
Verifier passes. Updating the memory note to correct the hyphen claim I found was wrong.

$ cd /data/workspace/.claude/agent-memory/findings-analyst; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='committee-pdf-extraction.md'; s=open(p).read()
old=[l for l in s.splitlines() if l.startswith('- **Verifier normaliser strips hyphens')][0]
new=('- **Verifier normaliser does NOT strip ASCII hyphens** (corrected 2026-10-17; an earlier note said it did). Its BULLET_RE is a '
     'private-use range U+E000–U+F8FF plus • ▪ ● ⁃ …; en/em dashes become "-" and stay. So keep "-" wherever plain text prints it '
     '(e.g. "Actual level - this", "15 -25"); bullets may be dropped. Quotes must be ≥12 chars: quote a short cell (e.g. a one-word cell) together with the next cell. '
     '**How to apply:** in the build script, import `normalise` from scripts/verify_history.py instead of re-implementing it, so the pre-check cannot drift from the verifier.')
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "hyphen" committee-pdf-extraction.md | cut -c1-120

I've written `outputs/history.json`, and the verifier now prints **ALL CHECKS PASSED** (128 sourced items, all 128 quotes found on their stated pages). An earlier `history.json` was already in `outputs/`; I rebuilt it from the PDFs without reading it, and the new one replaces it.

**Papers read:** all four expected PDFs: the 2024/25 annual appendix (2 pages), the Q3 2025/26 appendix (1 page), the Audit Plan 2025–28 covering report (7 pages) and the Risk Management Strategy 2024–27 (35 pages).

**Audits (20 rows: 16 completed audits, 3 follow-ups, 1 advisory)**
- **By opinion:** Reasonable 9, Substantial 5, Limited 2, Weak 1. Two rows say "Advisory – no opinion", one with "given" after it and one without (recorded as printed). The advisory review has no opinion column.
- **By procurement relevance:** direct 4 (Contract Letting, Accounts Payable, Direct Payments, Purchase of Residential and Nursing Care), adjacent 1 (Public Protection Partnership financial controls), none 15. These tags rest on the audit titles alone.

**Agreed actions and planned audits:** none found, so both lists are empty and the gap is recorded. The appendices give follow-up opinions only, and the covering report doesn't include Appendix D (the plan itself).

**Scoring method: usable.**
- Five-point likelihood and impact scales; for impact, the £ bands were turned into whole-pound figures.
- A 5×5 matrix where score = likelihood × impact (1–25), with all 25 cell labels as printed.
- Four RAG bands: up to 3 / 4–6 / 8–12 / 15–25.
- Appetite levels: financial Flexible (£250k–£500k), compliance Flexible/Open, reputation Open, operational Open.
- Corporate Risk Register threshold: the paper gives two conflicting figures (15 in Table 4, 9 or above in Figure 4). Both are recorded and neither is chosen.

**Gaps:** the Corporate Risk Register (exempt), plan Appendices A–F (including the anti-fraud plan), the covering reports for the two appendices, and the audit scopes and findings.

**Discrepancies (12 recorded, none resolved):**
- Section 4.3 calls Medium impact "(2)"; Table 1 prints it as 3.
- The Major and Medium budget-share bands overlap (0.25–0.3%).
- The matrix labels a score of 15 "High" in one cell but Table 4 puts 15 in Extreme.
- Table 4's band "Medium – High" doesn't match the matrix label "High".
- The reputation appetite is set as Open but uses Cautious wording.
- Smaller typos and naming differences ("extrene", "off", "Current Score", the committee name).

**Worth checking against the PDFs:**
1. Opinion: Garland is recorded as Weak / Unsatisfactory (2024/25 appendix, page 2).
2. Scale entry: impact 4 Major is recorded as £500k to £2M (strategy page 14).
3. Band: Medium – High is recorded as scores 8–12, Amber (strategy page 19).

**Memory:** I corrected one entry that was wrong. It said the verifier ignores hyphens when matching quotes; it doesn't, so a quote has to keep a "-" wherever the text prints one. The entry now also says to reuse the verifier's own normaliser when pre-checking quotes. The build script is at `/tmp/fa/build.py`.
